prompt: An alcohol is treated with TMSCl / Et₃N to form R-OTMS. To remove the TMS group later, which reagent is used?

options.label: TBAF (tetrabutylammonium fluoride) — F⁻ cleaves the Si–O bond selectively; also H₂O works for TMS specifically

explanation: F⁻ has an enormous affinity for Si (very strong Si–F bond, ~135 kcal/mol). TBAF cleaves silyl ethers back to the free alcohol under mild, orthogonal conditions. TMS specifically is also labile to water; bulkier silyl groups (TBS, TBDPS) need TBAF.
